body:
Im prescribed Adderall for ADHD. I dont want to say how much I am prescribed for privacy reasons.
The day I get my prescription filled, I make that day a party dosage day. I take 100 or 120 mgs in a single dose. When that hits me in about an hour, its like WOW! I feel so fucking Goddamned good. I feel like lightning. I feel like theres 10 million volts of electricity surging through me. The baseline depression I feel all the time because my life kind of sucks evaporates completely. My attitude becomes overwhelmingly positive. I experience the MDMA effect of wanting world peace and wishing the best for everyone.
Adderall is my favorite drug.
